title: Habits
intro: What you quit or cut down, and what you build — the gym, reading, a walk. A habit you quit counts every day since the start as clean unless you mark it; one you build counts the days you mark as done. Mark here, through the evening question in Telegram, or by telling the assistant. A slip starts the run again, but nothing you reached is taken away.
